answer: Every agent’s contribution is checked against a hidden wharf of histories tied to unique copper tokens, revealed only after a jade-stamped delay enforced by rotating auditors. Each fake identity must solve a bespoke puzzle, or the whole system halts—no bulk workarounds. The cost? Each added sybil burns an unpooled resource: auditor time, which can’t be farmed. More heads mean linear slowdown, not parallel gains.
